hints.text: 'Left' and 'unfinished' are our indicators. One is a deletion indicator, telling us to remove fodder from other fodder. The other is a selection indicator, telling us which part of some fodder to keep.
Our fodder is 'Bashful', 'plushy', and 'toy'. We'll need to find a synonym of one and use it with the letters of the other to construct our answer, as directed by the indicator(s).
The definition is 'Rejected dwarf', so our answer will be some kind of 'rejected dwarf' - but, fyi, we're not in the realm of fantasy here!
